newsitems.title: Path of Exile 1 Build Showcase: Spinning Magma Saboteur
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: If you like spicy, but spin-worthy builds, check out the Spinning Magma Saboteur build by Zurku351! It revolves around one thing though: a whole lot of magma! Using a combination of Cyclone, Cast While Channelling & Rolling Magma - start spinning, and let the magma do the rest! Thanks to Zurku351 for putting this build together. For more information, refer to their guide here. See you next time!

newsitems.title: The Last of the Druids Microtransactions Are Now Available in Store
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Microtransactions from the Last of the Druids Mystery Box have finally been released in the store for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2! From Armour Sets to Portals and Level-Up Effects, there are over 60 new microtransactions available, giving you even more ways to customise your Exile and show off your style. Check out the full selection in the store, or watch the video below to take a closer look at everything included in the Last of the Druids Mystery Box. Thank you for your support!

newsitems.title: Fan Art Competition
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: It’s been a while since we last hosted a fan art competition, and with the recent updates to Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2, we’re sure our community artists have plenty of inspiration to draw from. We’re excited to announce a Path of Exile Fan Art Competition inspired by the Return of the Ancients and Curse of the Allflame expansions! The prize pool includes official merchandise and in-game microtransactions. newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Yesterday, Path of Exile 1 Game Designers Andrew and Octavian sat down with community streamer Zizaran to discuss Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame. In case you missed it, check out the VOD below.

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 1: Curse of the Allflame Developer Interview
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: Later this week, Game Designers Octavian and Andrew will join Zizaran to discuss Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame. Tune in to hear the team discuss the latest developments and answer questions from the community. 2pm Tuesday August 4th PDT - at https://www.twitch.tv/zizaran See you there!

newsitems.title: After a year and a half of rigorous testing, Path of Exile 2 devs finally convinced Nvidia to fix a driver bug by sending it an entire PC
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: There was a point in the most recent Path of Exile 2 league that I thought I would have to quit playing the game. Every 20 minutes or so, the entire game would freeze. I'd wait for a solid 30 seconds before everything came back to life, praying I wouldn't lose my character the second I had control again... Read more.
